title: AiJobRunItem - Data API
description: Stores an individual item associated with a parent AiJobRun, including the inputs and resulting response. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AiJobRunId.description: A required reference to the parent AiJobRun record that this item belongs to. This field is a relationship field.

ErrorCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorCode.description: If processing for this item fails, this field contains a numeric code indicating the error.

ErrorMessage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorMessage.description: Contains a detailed, human-readable message that explains the reason for the job run item failure.

Input.description: Contains the input data for a single item within the job run. For example, in a PromptTemplate job, this is the JSON input for the prompt template.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: A unique, system-generated identifier for the AiJobRunItem record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The user or group that owns the AiJobRunItem record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PreprocessedInput.description: Stores an intermediate version of the input data after the preprocessing step. For example, this field could be a hydrated JSON prompt.

Response.description: Contains the generated response for the job item after processing is complete.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Tracks the status of the individual job item. Valid values are: Ready: The default value. The job run item is ready to start processing. Completed: Processing for the job run item is complete. Failed: Processing for the job run item failed.
